title: SpreadshopLayoutSettings
description: The layout options: which parts of the shop's own chrome are restyled, which fields a product card shows, and the colour overrides.

spreadshopLayoutSidebar.description: Shows the shop's header as a sidebar navigation.

spreadshopLayoutCompactFooter.description: Collapses the shop's footer into one row of service and legal links.

spreadshopLayoutCards.description: Adds product details from the shop's own data to the list tiles.

spreadshopLayoutProductPage.description: Restyles the product page: separated sections, tabs for its details, a tidier design, tags and sharing block.

spreadshopCardFields.description: Fields a product card shows after the name, in display order. hoverImage sits on the image, so its position has no effect and it is kept last.

spreadshopStartList.description: What the shop opens on when no start token or deeplink is set.

spreadshopColors.description: Colour overrides; an absent key falls back to the theme's mapping, then to the plugin default.
